meta.name: firebase-auth-basics
meta.description: Guide for setting up and using Firebase Authentication. Use this skill when the user's app requires user sign-in, user management, or secure data access using auth rules.

copy.tagline: 为应用接入用户登录与认证管理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在开发需要用户身份验证的应用
copy.tagline_en: Integrate user sign-in and authentication management into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building an app that requires user authentication

howto.what: Claude 会指导你设置 Firebase 用户登录，包括启用邮箱/密码、Google 等登录方式，并配置安全规则。
howto.when: 当你的应用需要用户登录、用户管理或通过认证规则保护数据时，Claude 会接管并提供设置指南。

say.text: 帮我用 Firebase 设置邮箱密码登录。
如何启用 Google 登录？
Firebase 认证的 ID Token 是什么？
say.note: Claude 会解释 ID Token 的用途和有效期。

howto.what_en: Claude will guide you through setting up Firebase user sign-in, including enabling email/password, Google, and other providers, and configuring security rules.
howto.when_en: When your app requires user sign-in, user management, or secure data access via auth rules, Claude will take over and provide setup guidance.

say_en.text: Help me set up email/password sign-in with Firebase.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to configure the emailPassword provider.

say_en.text: How do I enable Google Sign-In?
say_en.note: Claude will explain configuring googleSignIn in firebase.json and deploying.

say_en.text: What is an ID Token in Firebase Auth?
say_en.note: Claude will explain the purpose and expiry of ID Tokens.
